en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 26. And with the first chain of narration, from ‘Ali ibn Mahzyar, from ‘Ali ibn al-Nu’man, from Dawood ibn Farqad, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah Ja’far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon both of them, say:
"Surely, the righteous deeds will go to the Paradise to prepare for theirs doers, the way a person sends his servant to furnish for him.
Then he recited: ’And as for those who believe, and do righteous deeds, they prepare for their own souls’ (al-Rum, 30:44)."
